sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND ci.name = 'Khamis Mushait' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT e.name FROM ( SELECT o.employee_id, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders o WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' GROUP BY o.employee_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) emp_stats JOIN employees e ON e.id = emp_stats.employee_id ORDER BY (CAST(cancelled_orders AS REAL) / total_orders) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-09' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT e.name FROM ( SELECT o.employee_id, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)),0) - COALESCE(SUM(rt.refund_amount),0), 2) AS net_rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id AND substr(rt.returned_at,1,4)='2025' WHERE o.status='delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09' GROUP BY o.employee_id ) emp JOIN employees e ON e.id = emp.employee_id ORDER BY emp.net_rev DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date,6,2) IN ('01','02','03')
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Ghamdi Logistics'

SELECT seg.segment FROM ( SELECT cu.segment AS segment, SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' GROUP BY cu.segment ) seg ORDER BY seg.avg_units DESC, seg.segment LIMIT 1

SELECT cat.name FROM (SELECT c.id, c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY c.id) AS cat ORDER BY cat.revenue DESC, cat.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT month FROM (SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rt.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(oi.id) AS return_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id
WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2024'
GROUP BY month)
ORDER BY return_ratio DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM ( SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0)) - COALESCE(SUM(rt.refund_amount),0) AS net_rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id AND rt.returned_at BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-12' GROUP BY o.employee_id ) emp_rev JOIN employees e ON e.id = emp_rev.employee_id ORDER BY emp_rev.net_rev DESC, e.name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Makkah'

SELECT month FROM (SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT rt.id) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) AS ratio FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' GROUP BY month) ORDER BY ratio DESC, month LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Stationery' AND p.active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Asir'
SELECT unit_price FROM products WHERE sku = 'SKU-0012'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers cu WHERE cu.created_at < '2025-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = cu.id AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01')

SELECT p.name FROM (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-06' GROUP BY oi.product_id) pm JOIN products p ON p.id = pm.product_id ORDER BY pm.margin DESC, p.name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'low' AND substr(opened_at,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Household' AND p.active = 1

SELECT ci.name FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-10' AND '2024-12' GROUP BY ci.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, ci.name LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(MAX(p.unit_price), 2) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Bakery'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) IN ('2025-07','2025-08','2025-09')
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Mohammed Al-Ghamdi'

SELECT name FROM (SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2024-07','2024-08','2024-09') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.name LIMIT 2) ORDER BY revenue ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'wallet' AND substr(paid_at,1,4) = '2024' AND substr(paid_at,6,2) IN ('01','02','03')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND topic = 'billing'

SELECT cu.segment FROM (SELECT cu.segment, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders_cnt, SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09' GROUP BY cu.segment) ORDER BY avg_units DESC, segment LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'DHL' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date,1,4)='2025' GROUP BY customer_id INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY customer_id)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date,6,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '06' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date,1,4)='2024' GROUP BY customer_id INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY customer_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT cu.id FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id GROUP BY cu.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 5 ) AS cust5 JOIN ( SELECT st.customer_id, AVG((julianday(st.closed_at) - julianday(st.opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_res FROM support_tickets st WHERE st.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.customer_id ) AS ct ON ct.customer_id = cust5.id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS overall_avg FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL ) AS oa WHERE ct.avg_res > oa.overall_avg
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Qassim'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT cu.id FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id GROUP BY cu.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 2 ) AS cust_with_orders JOIN ( SELECT st.customer_id, AVG((julianday(st.closed_at) - julianday(st.opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_res FROM support_tickets st WHERE st.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.customer_id ) AS cust_avg ON cust_avg.customer_id = cust_with_orders.id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS overall_avg FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL ) AS overall WHERE cust_avg.avg_res > overall.overall_avg

SELECT cat.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) <= '2025-06' GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, cat.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND ci.name = 'Duba' ORDER BY e.name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'card' AND substr(paid_at,1,4) = '2024' AND substr(paid_at,6,2) BETWEEN '10' AND '12'
SELECT ROUND(MAX(p.unit_price), 2) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Snacks'

SELECT region_name FROM (
  SELECT r.name AS region_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id
  JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id
  WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    AND (
        substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06'
        OR substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06'
    )
  GROUP BY r.id
) grp
ORDER BY (rev_2025 - rev_2024) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) IN ('2025-10','2025-11','2025-12') GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),2) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise'

SELECT t.name FROM (SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09' GROUP BY p.id) AS t ORDER BY t.margin DESC, t.name LIMIT 3

SELECT name FROM (
  SELECT r.id, r.name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id
  JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id
  WHERE o.status='delivered'
    AND substr(o.order_date,6,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '06'
  GROUP BY r.id
) sub
WHERE rev_2024>0
ORDER BY ((rev_2025 - rev_2024) * 1.0 / rev_2024) DESC
LIMIT 1
